{{Quote|His light green eyes would be vibrant (as most Kerestian eyes are) if he had not been injured in an explosion at the Clariv Shipyards some years ago.|Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on Milacass|<ref name="AIR" />}}
'''Clariv''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Clariv system/Legends|Clariv system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Back Spiral]] area of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], which was situated in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]<ref name="Xim" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Clariv lay between the [[Erediss system|Erediss]] and [[Rudrig system/Legends|Rudrig systems]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Tion Trade Route]].<ref name="Xim" />

Clariv was the site of the bustling<ref name="Xim" /> [[Clariv Shipyards]],<ref name="AIR" /> with a large portion of the business there being conducted for interests in the nearby [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath]] and [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sectors]].<ref name="Xim" /> Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to<ref name="AIR" /> [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Milacass]] was injured in an explosion at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="AIR" /> Clariv was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] learned of the fact shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the world became the target of a brutal Imperial subjugation.<ref name="Xim" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clariv was introduced in the form of a mention of the Clariv Shipyards in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] first identified Clariv as a distinct world.<ref name="Xim" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Clariv [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Clariv itself, in grid square S-6.<ref name="TEA" />
